title: Navigation API: Dangling ongoing navigate event causes inconsistent behavior in tests
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

This issue is somewhat similar to #11802.

In Gecko's implementation, [this test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/156bb7cbb8483f6ffd4b275a1ed0b628fd0582cc/navigation-api/ordering-and-transition/transition-cross-document.html#L17) fails, because [#apply-the-history-step](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#apply-the-history-step:~:text=Set%20the%20ongoing%20navigation%20for%20navigable%20to%20%22traversal%22%2E) called from [#reload](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#reloading-and-traversing:apply-the-reload-history-step) aborts the event created in [#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event), which hasn't been cleared because #commit-a-navigate-event goes through [this path](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm:~:text=Otherwise%2C%20if%20apiMethodTracker%20is%20non%2Dnull%2C%20then%20clean%20up%20apiMethodTracker%2E). (I assume the intent was that it's fine to not clear the ongoing navigate event for cross-document navigations?)

However, when clearing the ongoing navigate event [here](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#commit-a-navigate-event:~:text=reason%2E-,Otherwise), [this test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/156bb7cbb8483f6ffd4b275a1ed0b628fd0582cc/navigation-api/navigate-event/signal-abort-window-stop.html) fails, because `window.stop()` requires the "dangling" ongoing navigate event to [signal abort](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#aborting-a-document-load:set-the-ongoing-navigation).

I don't see right away what's the best way of fixing this. Leaving the dangling `ongoing navigate event` on the navigation seems like a bad idea, but the `window.stop` case would otherwise change from aborting to event not firing and promises never settling.

cc @noamr @farre @smaug----
